confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Polish price levels, extrapolated to July 2026 peak season; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the beer anchor using typical local price ratios because direct knowledge is weaker. Hostel and hotel rates are least certain given peak-season and district variation. The FX rate comes from a search-result summary citing the RBA exchange-rates page; that page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned from other Polish tourist cities such as Wroclaw and Gdansk for food and drink prices, with Prague and Budapest as an upper reference for hotel tiers; a peak-season premium is applied to lodging. No specific comparable-city dataset was used.
